GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2022-08-19T07:31:43Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Configured background pool size does not match system.settings
Description: **Describe what's wrong**

Value of background_fetches_pool_size configured in config.xml (as per #36425):

```xml
<background_fetches_pool_size>64</background_fetches_pool_size>
```

does not show system.settings which has the default value instead:

```sql
SELECT name, value FROM system.settings WHERE name LIKE 'background_fetches_pool_size'
┌─value─┐
│ 8     │
└───────┘
```

while the correct value shows in the log:

```
Initialized background executor for fetches with num_threads=64, num_tasks=64
```

and BackgroundFetchesPoolTask sometimes exceeds the default so it looks like it's actually using the configured value

**Does it reproduce on recent release?**

Yes (suppose 22.8 LTS will be added to version_date.tsv)

**How to reproduce**

ClickHouse server version 22.8.1.2097
